title: win-cmd-rs variables
description: Configuration variables for win-cmd-rs (wincmd interpreter and wincheck batch static analyzer).

WIN_CMD_RS_INSTALL_METHOD.description: How to install win-cmd-rs. 'libscript_native' downloads prebuilt GitHub Release binaries into isolated version directories, 'system' uses the OS package manager, and 'from-source' compiles with Cargo.

WIN_CMD_RS_VERSION.description: Specific version or alias of win-cmd-rs to install.

WIN_CMD_RS_DOWNLOAD_URL.description: Override URL or template ({VERSION}, {RUST_TARGET}, {EXT}) for downloading win-cmd-rs release archives.

WIN_CMD_RS_RELEASES_URL.description: Override URL for querying available remote win-cmd-rs GitHub releases.

WIN_CMD_RS_CHECKSUM.description: Optional explicit SHA-256 digest override for verifying custom win-cmd-rs release archives.

WIN_CMD_RS_REPO_DIR.description: Optional local checkout path for compiling win-cmd-rs offline when using the from-source method.
